answer: The established kernel grows by at most 10% per epoch: one terrace of 17 seats (E47: 171), drawn by beacon from a ticket set frozen before the beacon, the Lotus draw; one ticket per funding tree holding a passed line, none carried over. At N=457 tickets a seat costs ~27 tickets, i.e. ~150 settled lines (18% pass); n trees buy 17n/(N+n) seats: linear only while n<<N. Cheapest bypass: exchange-withdrawal trees, so cost is lines, not identities. Honest newcomers wait ~27 epochs (~7 days) on average.
